title: Rule
description: An Advisor rule that defines detection logic for a specific system issue, along with resolution steps and remediation guidance.

rule_id.description: The unique identifier of the rule.

description.description: A description of what the rule detects.

active.description: Whether the rule is currently active.

category.description: The category the rule belongs to.

impact.description: The impact level of the rule.

risk_of_change.description: The risk associated with applying the remediation.

has_playbook.description: Whether an Ansible remediation playbook is available.

systems_affected.description: The number of systems currently affected by this rule.

resolution_set.description: Available resolution options for the rule.

resolution.description: The resolution description in markdown format.

has_playbook.description: Whether this resolution has a playbook.
